// Added through go test -overlay. Every call in the selected original Go tests compares the port
// while the original test's temporary files still exist. The original assertions still run.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/format/formatfiles"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func adamicCompare(input map[string]any, want string) {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(input)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	failures := ""
	for _, variable := range []string{"ADAMIC_NATIVE_PROBE", "ADAMIC_NODE_PROBE", "ADAMIC_BACKEND_PROBE"} {
		path := os.Getenv(variable)
		if path == "" {
			continue
		}
		command := exec.Command(path, string(raw))
		var stderr strings.Builder
		command.Stderr = &stderr
		stdout, err := command.Output()
		if err != nil || stderr.Len() != 0 || string(stdout) != want {
			failures += fmt.Sprintf("%s input %s: error %v stderr %s\ngot %q\nwant %q\n", variable, raw, err, stderr.String(), stdout, want)
		}
	}
	if failures != "" {
		panic(failures)
	}
}
func locateProject(request locationRequest) (projectLocation, error) {
	result, err := adamicGoLocateProject(request)
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(request)
	input := map[string]any{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &input); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	input["kind"] = "location"
	message, note := "", ""
	if err != nil {
		message = err.Error()
	} else {
		note = result.rootNote()
	}
	want := fmt.Sprintf("%q\t%q\t%q\t%q\t%q\t%t\t%q\t%q\t%q\n", message, result.Root, result.Engine, result.ConfigFileName, result.LintConfigFileName, result.LintConfigFileNameGiven, result.ArgumentBase, result.WorkingDirectory, note)
	adamicCompare(input, want)
	return result, err
}
func adamicScope(result formatScope, err error) string {
	message := ""
	if err != nil {
		message = err.Error()
	}
	text := fmt.Sprintf("%q\t%q\t%t\t%d\t%q\n", message, result.Description, result.Everything, result.DependentCount, result.RequestDescription)
	for _, file := range result.FileNames {
		text += strconv.Quote(file) + "\n"
	}
	return text
}
func namedPathsScope(cwd, root string, names []string) (formatScope, error) {
	result, err := adamicGoNamedPathsScope(cwd, root, names)
	adamicCompare(map[string]any{"kind": "named", "cwd": cwd, "root": root, "names": names}, adamicScope(result, err))
	return result, err
}
func (scope formatScope) narrowTo(population map[string]struct{}) formatScope {
	result := scope.adamicGoNarrowTo(population)
	var files []string
	for name := range population {
		files = append(files, name)
	}
	adamicCompare(map[string]any{"kind": "narrow", "files": scope.FileNames, "description": scope.Description, "request": scope.RequestDescription, "everything": scope.Everything, "population": files}, strconv.Quote(scope.Description)+"\n"+adamicScope(result, nil))
	return result
}
func (scope formatScope) narrowToEnumeration(enumeration formatfiles.Enumeration) formatScope {
	result := scope.adamicGoNarrowToEnumeration(enumeration)
	var layers, declined []string
	for name, count := range enumeration.IgnoredByLayer {
		layers = append(layers, fmt.Sprintf("%s\t%d", name, count))
	}
	for name, count := range enumeration.DeclinedExtensions {
		declined = append(declined, fmt.Sprintf("%s\t%d", name, count))
	}
	input := map[string]any{"kind": "enumeration", "files": scope.FileNames, "description": scope.Description, "request": scope.RequestDescription, "everything": scope.Everything, "root": enumeration.Root, "walked": enumeration.Walked, "symbolicLinks": enumeration.SymbolicLinks, "handled": enumeration.Files, "nested": enumeration.NestedRepositories, "layers": layers, "declined": declined, "formattable": len(enumeration.Files)}
	adamicCompare(input, strconv.Quote(describeEnumeration(enumeration, len(enumeration.Files)))+"\n"+strconv.Quote(scope.Description)+"\n"+adamicScope(result, nil))
	return result
}

func resolveOwnership(found *discovery) (ownership, error) {
	input := map[string]any{"kind": "ownership", "root": found.Root, "projects": append([]discoveredProject(nil), found.Projects...), "refused": found.Refused, "nested": found.NestedRepositories}
	result, err := adamicGoResolveOwnership(found)
	message := ""
	if err != nil {
		message = err.Error()
	}
	text := strconv.Quote(message) + "\n"
	for _, project := range found.Projects {
		text += fmt.Sprintf("project\t%q\t%q\t%q\n", project.Directory, project.Engine, project.ConfigFile)
	}
	for _, label := range result.Solutions {
		text += fmt.Sprintf("solution\t%q\n", label)
	}
	for _, label := range result.Yielding {
		text += fmt.Sprintf("yielding\t%q\n", label)
	}
	var labels []string
	for label := range result.Yields {
		labels = append(labels, label)
	}
	sort.Strings(labels)
	for _, label := range labels {
		yield := result.Yields[label]
		text += fmt.Sprintf("yield\t%q\n", label)
		for _, file := range yield.Files {
			text += fmt.Sprintf("file\t%q\n", file)
		}
		for _, directory := range yield.Directories {
			text += fmt.Sprintf("directory\t%q\n", directory)
		}
	}
	labels = nil
	for label := range result.SharedDirectory {
		labels = append(labels, label)
	}
	sort.Strings(labels)
	for _, label := range labels {
		text += fmt.Sprintf("shared\t%q\n", label)
	}
	adamicCompare(input, text)
	return result, err
}
func childArguments(arguments []string, lintConfig string) []string {
	result := adamicGoChildArguments(arguments, lintConfig)
	text := ""
	for _, argument := range result {
		text += strconv.Quote(argument) + "\n"
	}
	adamicCompare(map[string]any{"kind": "child", "arguments": arguments, "lintConfig": lintConfig}, text)
	return result
}

func TestAdamicCommandFilesystemEdges(t *testing.T) {
	wholeTreeScope().narrowToEnumeration(formatfiles.Enumeration{Root: "/links", Walked: 4, SymbolicLinks: 2, Files: []string{"/links/a.ts", "/links/b.ts"}})
	root := t.TempDir()
	writeTree(t, root, map[string]string{"tsconfig.json": "{}", "src/.gitignore": "hidden/\n", "src/hidden/a.ts": "", "src/z.ts": "", "src/é.ts": "", "src/ａ.ts": "", "src/😀.ts": ""})
	for name, target := range map[string]string{"src/alias": "hidden", "src/dangling": "missing", "directory-link": "src"} {
		if err := os.Symlink(target, filepath.Join(root, name)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	for _, names := range [][]string{{"src"}, {"directory-link"}, {"src/z.ts", "src/z.ts", "src/é.ts", "src/😀.ts"}, {".", "missing"}, {"src/dangling"}} {
		_, _ = namedPathsScope(root, root, names)
	}
	for _, config := range []string{
		`{"files":[],"references":[{"path":"./tsconfig.app.json"},{"path":"./missing.json"},{"path":"./node_modules/blocked.json"}]}`,
		`{"files":[],"\u0072eferences":[{"path":"./tsconfig.app.json"}]}`,
	} {
		writeTree(t, root, map[string]string{"tsconfig.json": config, "tsconfig.app.json": `{"include":["src"],"references":[{"path":"./tsconfig.json"}]}`, "node_modules/blocked.json": `{"include":["../src"]}`})
		_, _ = ownedDiscoveryForAdamic(root)
	}
}
func ownedDiscoveryForAdamic(root string) (discovery, error) {
	found, err := discoverProjects(root, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return found, err
	}
	found.Ownership, err = resolveOwnership(&found)
	return found, err
}

func discoveryRoot(location projectLocation, locateError error, cwd string) string {
	result := adamicGoDiscoveryRoot(location, locateError, cwd)
	message := ""
	if locateError != nil {
		message = locateError.Error()
	}
	adamicCompare(map[string]any{"kind": "discovery-root", "root": location.Root, "error": message, "cwd": cwd}, strconv.Quote(result)+"\n")
	return result
}
func discoveryApplies(given map[string]bool, names []string) bool {
	result := adamicGoDiscoveryApplies(given, names)
	var keys []string
	for name, present := range given {
		if present {
			keys = append(keys, name)
		}
	}
	adamicCompare(map[string]any{"kind": "discovery-applies", "given": keys, "names": names}, strconv.FormatBool(result)+"\n")
	return result
}

func TestAdamicScopeTiming(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("ADAMIC_COMMAND_TIMING") == "" {
		t.Skip("optional enumeration timing")
	}
	const count = 512
	root := t.TempDir()
	files := map[string]string{}
	for index := 0; index < count; index++ {
		files[fmt.Sprintf("files/%04d.ts", index)] = "export {};\n"
	}
	writeTree(t, root, files)
	input := map[string]any{"kind": "named", "cwd": root, "root": root, "names": []string{"files"}}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	result, err := adamicGoNamedPathsScope(root, root, []string{"files"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := adamicScope(result, nil)
	adamicCompare(input, want)
	for round := 0; round < 3; round++ {
		start := time.Now()
		answer, err := adamicGoNamedPathsScope(root, root, []string{"files"})
		output := adamicScope(answer, err)
		elapsed := time.Since(start)
		if output != want {
			t.Fatal("timed Go result changed")
		}
		t.Logf("Go scope plus canonical output round %d: %.6fs, %.0f files/s", round, elapsed.Seconds(), count/elapsed.Seconds())
		start = time.Now()
		command := exec.Command(os.Getenv("ADAMIC_NATIVE_PROBE"), string(raw))
		var stderr bytes.Buffer
		command.Stderr = &stderr
		actual, err := command.Output()
		elapsed = time.Since(start)
		if err != nil || stderr.Len() != 0 || string(actual) != want {
			t.Fatalf("timed native disagrees: %v %s", err, stderr.String())
		}
		t.Logf("native scope plus canonical output and process startup round %d: %.6fs, %.0f files/s", round, elapsed.Seconds(), count/elapsed.Seconds())
	}
}
